en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town and its railway station taken from an elevated grassy field. In the middle stands a brick station building with a gabled roof and a long platform structure. Next to it is a taller station house with several windows. Railway tracks and an empty, wide dirt or gravel area run horizontally across the foreground. Behind the station are compact townhouses, a church spire in the distance, and to the far right a larger ornate brick building with decorative gables. The landscape beyond the town is flat, open countryside stretching to the horizon. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European rural railway town.
